# odigos-central Provider

Manages Odigos Central: connected clusters, namespace selection, and workload instrumentation. The provider always connects to the Central API over HTTPS. Set `hostname`, `username`, and `password` here or via `ODIGOS_HOSTNAME`, `ODIGOS_USERNAME`, and `ODIGOS_PASSWORD`. `insecure_skip_verify` (or `ODIGOS_INSECURE_SKIP_VERIFY`) disables TLS certificate and hostname verification and should be used only with a self-signed or otherwise untrusted Central certificate.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "odigos-central" {
  hostname = "<hostname>"
  username = "<username>"
  password = "<password>"

  # The provider always connects over HTTPS. Uncomment only when Central
  # presents a self-signed or otherwise untrusted certificate.
  # insecure_skip_verify = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `hostname` (String) The Odigos API hostname. Can also be set via ODIGOS_HOSTNAME.
- `insecure_skip_verify` (Boolean) Skip verification of the Odigos API's TLS certificate and hostname. The connection stays encrypted but becomes vulnerable to man-in-the-middle attacks, so enable this only when Central presents a self-signed or otherwise untrusted certificate, such as on a dev or test cluster. Defaults to false. Can also be set via ODIGOS_INSECURE_SKIP_VERIFY.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) The Odigos API password. Can also be set via ODIGOS_PASSWORD.
- `username` (String) The Odigos API username. Can also be set via ODIGOS_USERNAME.
